title: Recover record draft
newRecord: This draft has not been saved as a record. Save to add it to its lab book. Its original identity and content will be preserved.
removedRecord: This record was removed after the draft began. Choose your draft to restore it privately, or keep the current absence. Earlier revisions remain available.
description: Independent changes are combined. Review each overlapping change and choose which version to keep. Your choices are saved so you can close this review and return later. Saving creates a new record version and removes this recovered checkpoint.
loading: Preparing the retained versions for review…
noConflicts: No overlapping changes. Saving will combine your draft with independent changes already saved to this record.
failed: The recovery operation did not complete. Your checkpoint and saved choices are retained.
editHelp: Changes are kept automatically. Return to the review when ready.
backToReview: Keep changes and return to review
changedContext: The workspace changed. Reopen the checkpoint in its original workspace.
conflictingCorrection: The checkpoint changed elsewhere. Your unacknowledged correction is still shown above. Copy it before closing. Reopen the checkpoint to inspect what was retained; submitted changes may already have been kept.
confirmDiscardCorrection: Close and inspect the retained checkpoint
